description: Report a problem with one deployment to Edgegap (the API's "Report a Deployment", meant for a studio's moderation backend), with a short reason and optional key/value details. It does not stop the deployment. Use it only when the developer asks to report a deployment; for a crash, read edgegap_get_deployment_logs first.

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

request_id.description: The exact request_id of the deployment.

name: edgegap_report_deployment
title: Report a deployment to Edgegap
